component.name: GoVault
component.summary: Native desktop client for Vaultwarden and Bitwarden servers

description.p: GoVault is a small, fast, native desktop client for Vaultwarden and Bitwarden-compatible servers. It keeps an encrypted copy of your vault on the device, so it opens and searches instantly, even offline.

ul.li: Logins with live verification codes, cards, identities, secure notes, SSH keys and attachments
Two-step login with an authenticator app or email
Vault Health: reused and weak passwords, expiring cards and unsecured websites, checked on your device
Password and passphrase generator, encrypted backups and a reviewed import
Copied secrets clear themselves from the clipboard, and the vault locks after inactivity

description.p: GoVault speaks English, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil) and Russian.

screenshot.caption: The vault with the sidebar, the item list and an item's details

description.p: Prerelease adding browser-based SSO/OIDC sign-in for desktop (Vaultwarden 1.37.4+ or Bitwarden) and the gv command-line client.
GoVault is also built for Intel Macs.

Select several items to move, trash, archive, restore or delete them together, find duplicate logins in Vault Health, sort the list, choose the server and appearance, and get real-time sync on bitwarden.com and bitwarden.eu.
Built on the official NSGo 0.3.0 release, with safer handling of the Windows Path and a fixed data race in the gv command-line client.
The gv command-line client shows verification codes on free bitwarden.com accounts too, computed on the device like the app.
GoVault adds gv, a command-line client compatible with the Bitwarden CLI, YubiKey OTP two-step login, new device verification, and attachment uploads on bitwarden.com.
On Linux, GoVault appears under Utilities in application menus and ships AppStream metadata for software centers.
SSH key items sync from Vaultwarden 1.37.5, the menu bar icon setting applies immediately, and screen readers read each sidebar row once.
GoVault speaks 10 languages and follows the system language, with a choice in Settings.
